items.title: Dave Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, Connecticut, November 21, 2001
items.q: You know who Tom Waits is?

ctx.x: Well they asked me to do a piece that they’re doing — the last time they did a piece like this they made about a million two hundred thousand for the poor, and they gave, through the BBC they gave all the money. And they do kind of far out things. So they’re doing Beethoven’s “Ode to Joy” and they’re asking all kinds of composers to contribute their version of “Ode to Joy.” You know who Tom Waits is? © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
